title: TF-IDF Vectorizer
hints: Tokenize with doc.lower().split(). Build the vocabulary as the sorted set of all tokens, then map each token to its column.
tf is the raw count of a term in a document. df is the number of documents that contain the term at least once.
idf = log((1 + n) / (1 + df)) + 1, with the natural log. Multiply each column of the count matrix by its idf.
Divide each row by its L2 norm. A row of all zeros (an empty document) stays all zeros.
